query: SELECT ol.device_id, ol.seq, ol.op_type, ol.payload, ol.created_at, ol.is_replicated AS "is_replicated!: bool" FROM op_log ol WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR ol.op_type = ?1) AND (?2 IS NULL OR ( ol.created_at < ?3 OR (ol.created_at = ?3 AND ol.seq < ?4) OR (ol.created_at = ?3 AND ol.seq = ?4 AND ol.device_id < ?6))) AND (?7 IS NULL OR ( ol.block_id IN (SELECT id FROM blocks WHERE space_id = ?7) OR ( ol.op_type IN ('delete_attachment', 'rename_attachment') AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attachments a WHERE a.id = json_extract(ol.payload, '$.attachment_id') AND a.block_id IN (SELECT id FROM blocks WHERE space_id = ?7) ) OR ( ol.op_type = 'delete_attachment' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM op_log src_add WHERE src_add.op_type = 'add_attachment' AND src_add.attachment_id = json_extract(ol.payload, '$.attachment_id') AND src_add.is_replicated = 0 AND src_add.block_id IN (SELECT id FROM blocks WHERE space_id = ?7) ) ) ) ) )) ORDER BY ol.created_at DESC, ol.seq DESC, ol.device_id DESC LIMIT ?5
